title: Adi Shankara and Advaita Vedanta
place: Kaladi, Kerala, India (per the oldest hagiographies)
summary: Adi Shankara taught Advaita Vedanta: the individual self is identical with Brahman. He wrote commentaries on the Brahma Sutras, principal Upanishads and Bhagavad Gita; his life is known from much later, legendary hagiographies.
why: A central teacher of Hindu philosophy whose fame grew mainly from the 14th century; tradition dates him far earlier.
